title: Living Together Now Spans Young Adults Through Later Life
hook: Living together is no longer merely a stop before marriage.
closing: Living together now marks a broader change across several stages of adult life.
question: Would you live together before marriage?

segments.say: Living with an unmarried partner reaches 9% among the youngest adults. It now exceeds living with a spouse.
Living with a spouse fell to 40% by 2018. Marriage became less dominant for the next age group.
Cohabiting adults aged fifty-plus reached 4.2 million by 2022. Living together also expanded later in life.
